name: Page shell
import: import { PageShell, PageTopRail, PageIntro, PageSection, PageBackButton } from "@/components/ui/page-shell"
description: Composable page content scaffold for width, rhythm, sticky controls, intro copy, sections, and back navigation.

PageShell.description: Page-level content wrapper used inside an app layout.

width.description: Maximum content width. On narrow mobile viewports, max-width variants naturally fill the available content track. Use full only when the page content already manages its own layout.

gap.description: Vertical rhythm between direct child sections.

bleed.description: Lets a section visually align to the app content edges. Use sparingly.

children.description: Usually PageIntro, optional PageTopRail, and PageSection children.

PageTopRail.description: Sticky row for tabs, filters, and compact page controls. Stays aligned to PageShell content by default.

children.description: Tabs, filter controls, segmented controls, or compact action rows.

PageIntro.description: Page title block with optional eyebrow, subtitle, meta, leading control, and actions.

meta.description: Compact metadata row under the intro.

leading.description: A PageBackButton or other compact leading control.

actions.description: Page-level actions composed from kubkit Button or other controls.

PageSection.description: Semantic section with consistent vertical rhythm.

PageBackButton.description: Small native back button for page intros and detail pages.

forbidden: Do not use PageShell as the app router layout, sidebar, or mobile header.
Do not wrap every PageSection in Card.
Do not put page-level actions inside random content cards when PageIntro actions can own them.
Do not use bleed by default.
Do not put large forms or long scrolling content in PageTopRail.

responsive.note: PageIntro actions wrap on small screens; PageTopRail stays sticky, scrolls horizontally when needed, and should contain touch-sized controls only. Width variants are max-widths, so narrow/default/wide can look identical on phone-sized viewports.

example:
<PageShell width="wide" gap="lg">
  <PageIntro title="Projects" subtitle="Track work across your team." actions={<Button>Create</Button>} />
  <PageTopRail>{/* tabs or filters */}</PageTopRail>
  <PageSection>{/* page content */}</PageSection>
</PageShell>
